g.text: in its name, but the description never
Rewrite one of them around what makes it different. If
really do the same thing, delete one; if they do not,
the first sentence of each should name the thing only that one
handles. Two descriptions this close are a coin flip at selection
time, and the model has no way to know it guessed wrong.
